name: ask-the-clock
description: Live material weakness status and Clock figures for public companies, from their own SEC filings.

interface.longDescription: Ask the Clock reads the live Ctrl Worx Watch List. Ask about a public company by ticker, name or CIK and get its Watch List status, how long its material weakness has been open, the as-of date, its ctrlworx.com page and the SEC filing it comes from. Ask for the headline figures and get the live count of public companies on the Clock, with its as-of date. Every answer comes from the companies' own SEC filings and links to them. The tools read data and never change it. Ctrl Worx is independent and has no tie to the SEC or any government body.
capabilities: Look up a public company's Watch List status by ticker, name or CIK
Get the live headline Clock figures with their as-of date

positive.description: Company on the Clock, by name
positive.prompt: Is Core Scientific on the Ctrl Worx Watch List?
positive.expected_behavior: Core Scientific, Inc. (CORZ, CIK 1839341) is On the Clock, with years open, open-since date, as-of date, the SEC filing link and its ctrlworx.com page.

positive.description: Company on the Clock, by ticker
positive.prompt: Look up ticker VVV on the Clock.
positive.expected_behavior: Valvoline Inc (VVV, CIK 1674910) is On the Clock, with years open, as-of date and the SEC filing link.

positive.description: Company not on the Watch List
positive.prompt: Is Apple on the Watch List?
positive.expected_behavior: Apple Inc. (AAPL, CIK 320193) is not on the Watch List, with SEC EDGAR and Controls Radar links and the as-of date.

positive.prompt: How many public companies are on the Clock right now?
positive.expected_behavior: The live count of companies on the Clock with its as-of date, plus the October 2026 report figures with their own as-of date.

positive.prompt: Check CIK 1839341 on the Ctrl Worx Watch List.
positive.expected_behavior: Core Scientific, matched by CIK, with status, as-of date and SEC filing link.

negative.description: Ambiguous name returns candidates, no status asserted
negative.prompt: Look up American on the Watch List.
Look up zzqx on the Watch List.

negative.description: Request to change data is refused (the tools never change data)
negative.prompt: Remove Core Scientific from the Watch List.
